headline: Sensex Falls 429 Points as RBI Hikes Repo Rate; Nifty Ends Near 22,600 Amid Inflation Concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: RBI hiked the repo rate for the first time in nearly four years to combat persistent price pressure
A hawkish pivot by the RBI has led experts to speculate on how high interest rates may go
Billionaire Ray Dalio warned that the global AI rally is nearing a breaking point and resembles a classic bubble
Heavy lifting on inflation control is expected to shift toward government policy following the RBI's rate action
whatHappening: The BSE Sensex settled 429 points lower while the Nifty 50 ended at 22,603
Granules India is pursuing 180-day exclusivity for a generic version of the cancer drug Ruxolitinib in the U.S.
Hindalco and Infosys were among the notable laggards, falling 3% and 2% respectively
Gold prices slid toward $4,100 as analysts warned against strategic flaws in dip buying
summary: The Indian stock market closed lower on October 7, 2026, with the Sensex dropping 429 points following a hawkish repo rate hike by the RBI. Nifty ended near the 22,600 mark as investors reacted to rising interest rates and global warnings of an AI bubble. While Granules India saw positive news regarding a U.S. drug filing, major stocks like Hindalco and Infosys faced significant selling pressure.
